chemical-bund-50l.shortDescription: 50L polyethylene chemical bund for secondary containment beneath the matching 50L Chemical Dosing Tank.
chemical-bund-50l.description:
A **50L chemical bund** designed as a secondary-containment tray for the matching 50L Chemical Dosing Tank. This is the **bund-only** product for buyers looking for a compact **chemical spill containment bund** rather than a complete tank-and-bund package.

The polyethylene bund provides a dedicated containment area beneath the dosing tank and is sold separately so it can be added to an existing compatible tank installation.

- 50L chemical bund
- Secondary containment for the matching 50L dosing tank
- Polyethylene construction
- Approx. 480 mm top OD × 360 mm bottom OD × 425 mm high
- Bund only - tank sold separately
- Suitable for compatible chemical dosing installations
features: Fits the matching 50L Chemical Dosing Tank
recommendedFor: Secondary containment beneath a 50L chemical dosing tank

compliance.note: Secondary-containment accessory. Confirm chemical compatibility and site-specific containment requirements for the stored chemical, quantity, installation and jurisdiction.
